item.title: Driver Kills Two College Cyclists in Tennessee, Officials Say
item.description: Milligan University said two members of its cycling team had been killed. Five others were injured, officials said.
item.dc:creator: Michael Levenson
item.media:description: A driver struck members of the Milligan University cycling team on Highway 19 in Carter County, Tenn., on Wednesday morning, officials said. Two of the cyclists were killed, the school said.

item.title: Prosecutor Reduces Charges Against L.A.P.D. Whistle-Blower After Uproar
item.description: A Los Angeles officer faced prison for secretly recording colleagues making offensive remarks. The county prosecutor is reducing those charges after critics said they would discourage whistle-blowers.
item.dc:creator: Shawn Hubler and Tim Arango
item.media:description: Nathan Hochman, the district attorney, said that the original charges “sent the wrong message.”

item.title: Inside the Data Center Capital of the World

item.title: U.S. Will Try California Arson Suspect Again After Stunning Mistrial

item.title: Byron Donalds Is Favored to Become Florida’s First Black Governor
